updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP: Adaptive Scopes for SharePoint
updates.summary: Dynamic scoping capability now allows administrators to automatically target DLP policies to SharePoint sites based on attributes like URL, name, or custom metadata, eliminating the 100-site static limit and enabling scalable policy deployment without ongoing manual maintenance.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP: Faster Policy Sync (2 hours to 30 minutes)
updates.summary: Policy updates in Microsoft Purview now synchronize across your organization in 30 minutes instead of up to 2 hours, ensuring DLP protections take effect more quickly when administrators make changes.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP: Support for Non-Microsoft Connected Apps (Preview)
updates.summary: Organizations can now create DLP policies that protect sensitive data at rest in non-Microsoft applications such as Box and Google Workspace using existing Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps connectors and the same classification engine as Microsoft 365 locations.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Sensitivity Labels: Simulation Mode for Auto-Labeling Policies
updates.summary: Before enforcing auto-labeling policies, administrators can now run them in simulation mode to preview which items would be labeled and review match results and source distribution, reducing the risk of unintended labeling at scale.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Sensitivity Labels: Auto-Labeling for Non-Microsoft Apps (Preview)
updates.summary: Auto-labeling policies can now protect sensitive data at rest in non-Microsoft connected apps including Box and Google Workspace, extending classification and labeling capabilities beyond Microsoft 365 environments.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Security Investigations Integration with Endpoint DLP Alerts
updates.summary: Administrators can now launch Data Security Investigations directly from endpoint DLP alerts to quickly analyze exfiltrated content, with automatic gathering of related files that triggered the alerts based on defined queries.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP: Sensitive Data Protection in Microsoft 365 Copilot Web Search
updates.summary: DLP now prevents Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Chat from using sensitive data in external web searches, helping organizations mitigate data leakage and oversharing risks at the AI layer.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP: Policy Tips in Outlook for Mac
updates.summary: DLP policy tips now appear in Outlook for Mac, providing real-time notifications when emails contain sensitive information that violates organizational policies and allowing users to remove non-compliant recipients or override policies.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP: Policy Tips in Outlook Mobile
updates.summary: DLP policy tips now available on Outlook Mobile provide real-time alerts to help users avoid accidentally sharing sensitive information on mobile devices, ensuring compliance with organizational policies.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Data Lifecycle Management: Archive SharePoint Files Under Retention
updates.summary: Administrators can now add archiving actions to data retention policies in SharePoint Online, allowing files to be archived to low-cost storage while remaining discoverable and maintaining compliance throughout the content lifecycle.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Data Lifecycle Management: Retention Policies for Copilot Memory
updates.summary: Administrators can now configure retention policies for Microsoft 365 Copilot memory items stored in Exchange mailboxes, helping preserve historical versions for security, compliance, and investigation scenarios.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Data Lifecycle Management: Hard Delete for OneDrive and SharePoint
updates.summary: Data Lifecycle Management now provides hard delete capability through secure priority cleanup workflows for OneDrive and SharePoint, with multiple approval requirements to prevent inadvertent data loss.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP: Data Security Triage Agent with Confidence Scoring
updates.summary: The Data Security Triage Agent in DLP now provides reasoning traces and confidence scores for each decision, giving security analysts visibility into agent logic and reliability before acting on alerts.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Compliance Manager: AI Foundry Agent Compliance Integration
updates.summary: Compliance Manager now integrates with Microsoft AI Foundry to automatically map Agents to compliance regulations and assessments, showing compliance status and improvement actions for AI-generated solutions.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Compliance Manager: AI-Powered Regulatory Templates
updates.summary: Compliance Manager now offers AI-powered conversion of complex PDF regulations into actionable controls and actions for multi-cloud environments, accelerating the creation of compliance assessments and identification of gaps.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP: Text and Prompt Protection via Global Secure Access (Preview)
updates.summary: Organizations can now integrate DLP with Microsoft Entra Global Secure Access to intercept and inspect text and AI interactions at the network layer, preventing sensitive data from being shared with untrusted cloud applications and generative AI platforms.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Data Lifecycle Management: Triple-Approval Requirement for Priority Cleanup
updates.summary: Priority cleanup policies now require three separate approvals—from a Priority Cleanup administrator, retention manager, and eDiscovery administrator—before content is permanently deleted, adding critical oversight for destructive actions.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP: Exchange Online Classification Failure Detection
updates.summary: Exchange Online DLP policies can now detect and respond to classification failures caused by timeouts and throttling, allowing administrators to apply specific protection actions when scanning errors occur.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Data Governance: Azure SQL Database Support Removed
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview protection policies no longer support Azure SQL Database as a governance target, requiring administrators to evaluate alternative protection strategies for SQL databases.
